implementation: stage 3 working tree prepared for the stage commit
dataset: Two typed synthetic movements per month: cash 100 fen to target account and 300 fen to a distinct unrelated account; both have payable obligations. Real publish, six inventory confirmations, preview and close every month.
assertions: Each month has two balanced vouchers totaling 400 fen.
Target balance is 100 * months, total cash 400 * months.
There are 2 * months unsettled obligations totaling 400 * months.
Every checkpoint passes complete content, frozen adoption, projection and index verification.
counter_notes: Application SQL excludes Store connection validation and SQLite internal VM scans; returned rows/bytes are values actually returned to Python (integer scalar width 8).

Outcome decodes count json.loads of result payloads. SQLite json_extract work is represented by SQL counts and wall time, not Python decode counts. outcome_sql counts SQL text mentioning outcome; it is not a SQLite VM decode counter.
Target-account path uses old production FundsRead.account_summary versus new scoped balance_totals; funds_history compares the same full-summary API in both versions.
Cumulative movements explicitly depend on every prior calculation; their real dependency edges are retained and are quadratic. Current-page relations may require their full ancestry.
Database file bytes include retained WAL; logical database bytes exclude WAL duplication.

Construction operation samples were measured before final settlement-seal hardening; immutable business sources, dependency counts and close manifests remain unchanged. Projection seal repair and its read-repair revision are explicitly recorded. Construction-run wall times had concurrent pytest/background benchmark load. They do not establish a speedup; final-database historical-cutoff read rechecks are recorded separately when available and supersede earlier reader counts after final correctness fixes.

Final reader timing is a local three-repeat median, not a strict isolated-host benchmark: one 7-second schema-discovery test and small static checks overlapped the stage3 read window. Deterministic application SQL and returned-data counters remain separately reported.

stage3.timing_context: final-source-window-without-full-regression-or-package-build; one 7-second schema-discovery test and small static checks ran during the window; not an isolated performance host
